gates.title: every /s/<id> page has a First five minutes section
gates.evidence: delivery-schedule is the thirty-first server, built after the last user-value round, so no round has exercised it: first_five: [], first_five_round: null, no section. scripts/build-pages.mjs correctly emits nothing. Confirmed exactly one page has no round data and 31 of 32 have a section
gates.latent_bug_found: every one of these tests did html.slice(html.indexOf(heading)); indexOf returns -1 when absent and slice(-1) returns the LAST CHARACTER of the page, not "". A page with no section was checked against one character of unrelated markup, which is why one missing section reported as five unrelated defects (names round null, lead sentence disagrees with the scores, no source line). A helper now asserts the heading is present before slicing
gates.decision: option A: scope the assertions to servers a round has exercised, and report the uncovered ones visibly. Rejected option B (build-pages.mjs emits an honest no-round-yet section)
decision_why: build-pages.mjs has one contract, everything in that section was measured and a reader can check it. Writing a paragraph for a server nobody exercised breaks that contract to satisfy a test, which is the failure mode these gates exist to catch

option B would not have made the suite green on its own: first_five.length >= 1, the round line, the date line and the free-tier line all still fail against an evidence-free section, so it is option A plus a generator edit plus a regenerated pages.js plus a we-have-not-tested-this notice on a live sales page
a missing round should stay uncomfortable; writing the paragraph discharges the obligation without running the round
gates.assertion_is_stronger_not_weaker: was: every page has a section. now: a page carries a section EXACTLY WHEN a round has exercised it. Fails in both directions; the old form could only catch a generator that forgot to write one, the new one also catches a page that grew a section for a server no round has touched, which is fabricated evidence on a page with a Buy button
gates.scoping_is_derived: MEASURED is built from the round files themselves, so a server enters it the moment a round covers it; no exemption list to remember to delete from
gates.visible_gap: scripts/release-check.mjs gained a per-server first-five check using the file's existing gap() mechanism: cell reads gap, printed by name in the named-gaps section on every run, does not block. It fails as a blocker in the two dishonest directions (a measured server whose page lost its section, an unmeasured server whose page has one)

process_finding: four of the six stale things fixed here were stale TEST literals, not stale site copy (/s/bundle, servers/office-suite), /^Thirty MCP servers/, /198 tools/). Every one was a pinned string written as an anchor against a derived value going wrong, and every one went wrong itself first. An anchor typed into a test is a number on the live site with extra steps: it rots on the same schedule, where nobody is looking. Each replacement reads its anchor from a second independent source: the filesystem, the manifests, or the live route's own response.
